TextCfg.zh: Today is my first time cooking. What terrible thing happened?

TextCfg.zh: on fire! The flames blazed all of a sudden, and the kitchen became a sea of flames.
TextCfg.en: on fire! The flames blazed all of a sudden, and the kitchen became a sea of flames.
TextCfg.jp: 燃えている！炎が突然燃え上がり、台所は炎の海になりました。
TextCfg.fz: on fire! The flames blazed all of a sudden, and the kitchen became a sea of flames.

TextCfg.en: Why did I have such an accident?
TextCfg.jp: なぜ私はそのような事故に遭ったのですか？

TextCfg.en: It turned out to be a high number of red wine in his hand, no wonder it suddenly burned!

TextCfg.en: I covered it with a damp towel, and the fire was extinguished all at once. It was really thrilling!

TextCfg.fz: I covered it with a damp towel, and the fire was extinguished all at once. It was really thrilling!

TextCfg.zh: When the fire was extinguished, my hand was scalded! How to do?
TextCfg.en: When the fire was extinguished, my hand was scalded! How to do?
TextCfg.jp: 火が消えたとき、私の手はやけどを負った！実行する方法？
TextCfg.fz: When the fire was extinguished, my hand was scalded! How to do?

TextCfg.fz: I turned on the faucet and put my hands in the stream. It was finally safe, so let's apply some scald cream later.

TextCfg.jp: 浴槽に落ちて腰をひねったようだった。

TextCfg.zh: People outside cannot hear my call for help, why?

TextCfg.en: The bathroom door was locked, no wonder they didn't hear it at all.

TextCfg.en: I quickly pulled the plug off, and the water ran away. Haha, I'm so smart!

TextCfg.en: I'm cooking in the kitchen, what happened?

TextCfg.zh: The octopus sucked my face, which is too funny!
TextCfg.en: The octopus sucked my face, which is too funny!

TextCfg.zh: What tools can be used to get it down?
TextCfg.en: What tools can be used to get it down?

TextCfg.zh: Fortunately, there is a shovel in the kitchen, it should work!
TextCfg.en: Fortunately, there is a shovel in the kitchen, it should work!

TextCfg.zh: It's too uncomfortable, what else can I do?
TextCfg.en: It's too uncomfortable, what else can I do?

TextCfg.en: Scissors! ! ! This is a good thing, I can use it to cut off a few!

TextCfg.zh: There are so many octopus legs that I can't finish cutting them. What else can I do! !
TextCfg.en: There are so many octopus legs that I can't finish cutting them. What else can I do! !

TextCfg.zh: Oh! I remembered that if it touched water, the octopus would loosen its tentacles. I quickly turned on the tap, oops! Finally saved.
TextCfg.en: Oh! I remembered that if it touched water, the octopus would loosen its tentacles. I quickly turned on the tap, oops! Finally saved.

TextCfg.fz: Oh! I remembered that if it touched water, the octopus would loosen its tentacles. I quickly turned on the tap, oops! Finally saved.

TextCfg.en: What should I do, I am kidnapped by bad guys now, what's wrong?

TextCfg.en: The bad guy tied me up with rope, and couldn't move his hands and feet at all.

TextCfg.zh: After a while, the situation changed a bit, and I seemed to have a chance to escape.
TextCfg.en: After a while, the situation changed a bit, and I seemed to have a chance to escape.

TextCfg.zh: It turned out to be the key here. With the key, this obstacle will no longer exist.
TextCfg.en: It turned out to be the key here. With the key, this obstacle will no longer exist.

TextCfg.en: I have all the tools, but I still can’t move. What should I do?

TextCfg.en: It turned out that there was a candle behind me. I leaned back and the rope was burned! I am finally saved!

TextCfg.zh: Ruined! What else can I do! !

TextCfg.zh: There is a railway ahead, the railings are being put down, I can't make it through!
TextCfg.en: There is a railway ahead, the railings are being put down, I can't make it through!

TextCfg.zh: How can I reduce the speed of the car?

TextCfg.en: There is an umbrella in the back seat, I quickly open it and try it!

TextCfg.fz: The umbrella is broken! What else can I do to avoid danger?

TextCfg.zh: I rushed into the bushes, hey, the danger is finally over!
TextCfg.en: I rushed into the bushes, hey, the danger is finally over!

TextCfg.en: Today, at the subway station, a girl accidentally fell into the railroad tracks! What caused it?
TextCfg.jp: 今日、地下鉄の駅で、女の子が誤って線路に落ちました！何が原因ですか？
TextCfg.fz: Today, at the subway station, a girl accidentally fell into the railroad tracks! What caused it?

TextCfg.zh: Oh! It turned out that she was walking and playing with her mobile phone, and she accidentally stumbled and fell!
TextCfg.en: Oh! It turned out that she was walking and playing with her mobile phone, and she accidentally stumbled and fell!
TextCfg.jp: おお！彼女は歩いて携帯電話で遊んでいたことが判明し、偶然につまずいて転んだ！
TextCfg.fz: Oh! It turned out that she was walking and playing with her mobile phone, and she accidentally stumbled and fell!

TextCfg.zh: She tried to climb up to the platform, but for some reason, she couldn't climb up. Why?
TextCfg.en: She tried to climb up to the platform, but for some reason, she couldn't climb up. Why?
TextCfg.jp: 彼女はプラットホームに登ろうとしましたが、何らかの理由で登ることができませんでした。どうして？
TextCfg.fz: She tried to climb up to the platform, but for some reason, she couldn't climb up. Why?

TextCfg.zh: It turned out that when she fell, her knee was hurt and she couldn't use her strength at all. She was in a critical situation!
TextCfg.en: It turned out that when she fell, her knee was hurt and she couldn't use her strength at all. She was in a critical situation!
TextCfg.jp: 彼女が倒れたとき、彼女の膝は傷つき、彼女は彼女の力をまったく使うことができなかったことがわかった。彼女は危機的な状況にありました！
TextCfg.fz: It turned out that when she fell, her knee was hurt and she couldn't use her strength at all. She was in a critical situation!

TextCfg.zh: The male passenger on the platform seemed to have discovered something and hurried to act.
TextCfg.en: The male passenger on the platform seemed to have discovered something and hurried to act.

TextCfg.fz: The male passenger on the platform seemed to have discovered something and hurried to act.

TextCfg.zh: The enthusiastic passengers hurriedly pressed the emergency stop button. The problem seemed to be solved?
TextCfg.en: The enthusiastic passengers hurriedly pressed the emergency stop button. The problem seemed to be solved?

TextCfg.en: I was at work today, and there was a commotion in the corridor. What's the trouble?

TextCfg.fz: The office is newly built. There should be high-tech fire extinguishing facilities, but it does not seem to be activated?

TextCfg.en: The automatic sprinkler on the ceiling didn't move at all. It seems that today I can't count on it.

TextCfg.fz: The automatic sprinkler on the ceiling didn't move at all. It seems that today I can't count on it.

TextCfg.zh: Hurry up and think of a way to put out the fire!
TextCfg.en: Hurry up and think of a way to put out the fire!

TextCfg.fz: Hurry up and think of a way to put out the fire!

TextCfg.en: I opened the fire hydrant in the corridor, but the fire was so big that these small fire extinguishers couldn't save it.
TextCfg.jp: 廊下で消火栓を開けましたが、火が大きすぎて消火器で消火できませんでした。
TextCfg.fz: I opened the fire hydrant in the corridor, but the fire was so big that these small fire extinguishers couldn't save it.

TextCfg.zh: Can't wait any longer, run for my life!
TextCfg.en: Can't wait any longer, run for my life!
